notes: The armor slots live in the same surv_state struct as the main slots, so several getters cite the survival helpers that read them. storeItemStack exists twice in Java-shaped form: survival.c's inlined scan for the player and container.c's player_store_item for machine inventories. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): clearInventory and hasItemStack have no survival caller; the mouse wheel arrives as the hotbar slot. Formerly listed as missing: clearInventory (the /clear-style wipe) and hasItemStack have no native and no replayed caller. The mouse-wheel hotbar cycle (changeCurrentItem) is not replayed; acts carry the selected slot instead. func_70439_a's enchanted-current-item guard (currentItemStack cache) is missing; dev gives always replace.
